title: The Astonishing Possibilities of a Shuffled Deck
hook: What if every shuffled deck has never existed before?
script: What if every shuffled deck has never existed before? You create an order that has almost certainly never existed before. This is due to the sheer scale of possibilities, known as 52 factorial. 52 factorial equals about 8 followed by 67 zeros. There are more possible arrangements than atoms in the observable universe. Even after seven shuffles, most decks are statistically unique. The odds of two shuffled decks being identical is nearly one in 80 quintillion. Imagine laying out all arrangements; it would stretch over 10 billion light-years.
